app.name: Phone in Hand
home.detail.sensor_not_needed: Not needed while attached to a controller
home.detail.vrchat_off: VRChat isn't running, or OSC is off
home.info.iphone: You are using an iPhone. Wireless debugging isn't available, but the display works the same while attached to a controller.
home.warn.sensor_lost: Sensor data from your phone has stopped. The panel is following your hand's orientation instead.
mobile.battery_hint: Turning off battery optimization helps keep sending from stopping.
mobile.error_desc: Check that your PC and phone are on the same Wi-Fi and that the PC app is running.
mobile.idle_desc: Scan the QR code shown in the PC app.
mobile.leave_hint: You can go back to the home screen and use other apps.
settings.input.keep_awake: Keep the phone screen on while connected to VRChat
settings.vrchat.bits_note: Uses 2 bits of synced avatar parameters (visibility, hand).
unlock.android_extend: With Extend Unlock (formerly Smart Lock), "Trusted places" or "Trusted devices" keep your phone unlocked while the conditions are met (up to 4 hours).
unlock.android_fingerprint: Fingerprint and PIN work while you wear your headset.
unlock.android_stay_awake: While connected to VRChat, this app keeps your phone screen on (requires wireless debugging).
unlock.desc: Your headset covers your face, so face recognition can't unlock your phone. Review these settings before you start so unlocking in VR isn't a problem.
unlock.ios_autolock: Before you start, set Settings > Display & Brightness > Auto-Lock to "Never" so your phone doesn't lock midway. Change it back afterward.
unlock.ios_faceid: Face ID can't be used because your headset covers your face.
unlock.ios_watch: "Unlock with Apple Watch" is designed for faces covered by a mask, sunglasses, or goggles. Whether it works with a headset depends on your setup.
unlock.power_warn: Keeping the screen on uses more power. Keep your phone charging while you use it.
unlock.title: Prepare to unlock
wizard.calibrate.desc: Attach your phone to a controller with a holder and put on your headset. In VR, line up the screen guide with your phone and press the trigger to confirm.
wizard.calibrate.title: Calibrate position
wizard.calibrate.vr_hint: Put on your headset to continue. This screen moves on automatically when done.
wizard.mirror.desc: Receive your Android screen over wireless debugging or USB. No capture device needed.
wizard.mirror.hint_usb: USB gives lower latency and charges your phone. Allow "USB debugging" on your phone. For Wi-Fi, video appears after you pair wireless debugging in the next step.
wizard.mirror.secure_note: Apps that block screen capture appear black.
wizard.phone.adb_desc: Used to turn on "Show taps" automatically. In Developer options, open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code, then enter the IP address and code shown.
wizard.phone.desc: Connect to your phone with wireless debugging. Only if you use hand tracking, also install the sensor app and scan the QR code. Your PC and phone must be on the same Wi-Fi.
wizard.phone.install_note: Available after pairing. The installed app receives the connection details for this PC automatically.
wizard.phone.install_via_adb: Install the app via wireless debugging
wizard.phone.ios_note: With an iPhone, skip this step and continue with the button below.
wizard.phone.qr_hint: Scan it from "Scan QR code" in the app.
wizard.phone.title: Connect your phone
wizard.phone.waiting: Waiting for your phone to connect…
wizard.video.crop_hint: The area inside the dashed line is shown in VR.
wizard.video.desc: Select the capture device connected to your phone's HDMI output.
wizard.video.mirror_hint: Set your phone's output to screen mirroring. If a desktop mode starts, switch to mirroring in your phone's settings.
wizard.video.not_found_desc: Check the USB connection and try again. The device may also be hidden if another app is using it.
wizard.video.title: Choose video input
wizard.vrchat.desc: Enable OSC in VRChat's Action Menu and switch to an avatar that includes the phone model.
wizard.vrchat.guide_link: How to add it to your avatar
wizard.vrchat.title: Connect VRChat
wizard.window.desc: Use a window on your PC as the video. With an iPhone, combine it with an AirPlay receiver app's window.
wizard.window.hint: This app doesn't include an AirPlay receiver. Install one you like separately.
